# Local font export dependencies

The bundled font-tools.js includes:
- opentype.js 1.3.4 — MIT, https://github.com/opentypejs/opentype.js
- fonteditor-core 2.6.3 — MIT, https://github.com/kekee000/fonteditor-core
- polygon-clipping 0.15.7 — MIT, https://github.com/mfogel/polygon-clipping
- polygon-clipping's dependencies splaytree and robust-predicates, with license notices below.
- WOFF2 WebAssembly from fonteditor-core, based on Google WOFF2 and Brotli (MIT).

License texts accompany this file. The export runs locally; no fonts or projects are uploaded.
Build: esbuild 0.25.11, browser ESM, minified, fs/path external (Node-only branches).
